name: Ball Packaging Products
old_description: Since 2011, The Ball Foundation, the philanthropic extension of Ball Corporation, has amplified Ball’s organizational values through community partnerships. Today, The Ball Foundation supports over 15 community organizations dedicated to recycling education and infrastructure; science, technology, engineering and mathematics in manufacturing; and disaster relief and preparedness.
about:
Ball Packaging Products, operating as Ball Corporation, is headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. The company's founding year, founders, and ownership details are not specified in the available sources.

The company manufactures aluminum packaging including beverage cans, beverage bottles, aerosol cans, and ends. It operates 65-plus manufacturing plants across 49 countries, employs approximately 16,000 people, and ships more than 108 billion units annually. Its capabilities include digital printing on aluminum containers and the development of recycled-content aerosol technology.

Ball serves the beverage packaging industry, supplying cans for beer, water, soda, and other drinks, as well as aluminum bottles for sporting events and concert venues. It also provides aerosol packaging for personal care and household brands. Customers range from global beverage brands to regional bottlers.

Ball emphasizes circularity, with public 2030 commitments to achieve a 90 percent global recycling rate for aluminum beverage containers, 85 percent average recycled content in its aluminum, and a second-generation ReAl® aerosol container with 75 percent recycled content. The company states that its global scale and sustainability focus differentiate it in the market.
